notes.note: Scoped follow-up review of InlineBrowserActivity: placement actions now compose the shared ActionRow owner, preserving Float/Bring back before Open in pane, exact session/authority binding and the existing opener fallback. The custom wrapping rule and standalone action-inventory entry are removed; the canonical shared owner supplies layout and target floors. Both inline owner files pass four tests and the responsive inventory passes. The documented session, control and recording boundaries remain unchanged; actual production frames, physical input and release qualification are not established by this source review.
